entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts GM Chris Ballard said Tuesday that Pierce (ankle) is a "week or so away" from practicing, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Chris Bell
entries.summary: The Dolphins placed Bell (ACL) on the active/non-football injury list Tuesday.

entries.name: Chris Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks is on the Packers' active/non-football injury list during training camp due to a hamstring injury, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Noel
entries.summary: Noel's placement on the active/non-football injury list is due to a finger injury that could cause him to miss a few weeks, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Luke Musgrave
entries.summary: Packers GM Brian Gutekunst said Wednesday that Musgrave was placed on the active/PUP list due to a neck injury and that the team is working to diagnose whether the tight end is facing a long-term issue, Tom Silverstein of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Terrell Jennings
entries.summary: Jennings will open up training camp on the active/non-football injury list, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Tip Reiman
entries.summary: Reiman (ankle) was placed on the active/PUP list Thursday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Tyler Conklin
entries.summary: The Lions placed Conklin (knee) on the active/PUP list Sunday.

entries.name: Tyrell Shavers
entries.summary: The Bills placed Shavers (knee) on the active/PUP list Tuesday, Matt Parrino of The Syracuse Post-Standard reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: The Seahawks have placed Charbonnet (knee) on the physically unable to perform list ahead of training camp, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
entries.summary: Rodriguez (foot) has been cleared to practice, but the Jaguars intend to take a cautious approach with the running back's participation level early in training camp, John Shipley of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Kirk sustained a calf injury during Sunday's practice and is not practicing Monday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Cyrus Allen
entries.summary: Allen was diagnosed with a shin bruise on his left leg that he suffered during Saturday's training camp practice, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: Stribling will not participate in Saturday's training camp practice due to hamstring tightness, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

entries.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
entries.summary: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Thursday that he's "not even sweating" Gibbs' absence from training camp amidst contract negotiations, though Campbell also noted that the running back is dealing with minor back discomfort, ESPN.com's Eric Woodyard reports.

entries.name: Jake Bobo
entries.summary: Bobo did not participate in Tuesday's training camp practice due to a leg injury, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Conner (foot) isn't yet doing full-team drills at training camp, Darren Urban of azcardinals.com reports.

entries.name: Jordan James
entries.summary: James fractured a rib during Tuesday's practice, Vic Tafur of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai was absent from Friday's practice due to an undisclosed reason, Patrick Finley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

entries.name: Malik Nabers
entries.summary: Nabers (knee) said Thursday that he "felt great" after practicing Wednesday for the first time since having his torn ACL surgically repaired in October, Matt Citak of the Giants' official site reports.

entries.name: Michael Penix Jr.
entries.summary: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Friday that Atlanta's starters will likely see action in the team's first and third preseason games, but it remains to be seen whether Penix (knee) will be ready to take the field by then, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Mitchell Evans
entries.summary: Evans has been diagnosed with a low ankle sprain and is considered day-to-day, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

entries.name: Patrick Mahomes
entries.summary: Mahomes (knee) is participating in 11-on-11 team drills during Wednesday's training camp practice, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: Dell (knee) will be held out of full-team reps to open training camp, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Treylon Burks
entries.summary: Burks missed Thursday's practice with foot soreness, Ben Standig of Big 100 Washington D.C. reports.

entries.name: Tua Tagovailoa
entries.summary: Tagovailoa (back) did not take part in team drills Friday due to a "precautionary thing" related to back tightness and said he is unsure when he will be fully cleared for on-field activities, Marc Raimondi of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Tucker Kraft
entries.summary: Kraft (knee), who was activated from the active/PUP list Friday, took part in individual drills at his first practice of Packers training camp, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Xavier Worthy
entries.summary: Worthy is believed to avoided a serious shoulder injury that he sustained during the final session of Saturday's training camp practice, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Chris Brazzell II
entries.summary: The Panthers placed Brazzell (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Gunner Olszewski
entries.summary: Olszewski (Achilles) was placed on injured reserve by the Giants on Monday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: John Michael Gyllenborg
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Gyllenborg (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

entries.name: Ricky Pearsall
entries.summary: Pearsall was placed on injured reserve Saturday and will undergo season-ending PCL surgery on his right knee, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
